sources.quote: SpaceX successfully catches Starship after launch for the first time
Watch SpaceX successfully execute the first ‘chopstick’ catch of Starship

claims.statement: SpaceX's catch tower successfully caught the Starship vehicle for the first time.

sources.quote: While the company has pulled off this trick a few times with Super Heavy boosters, it was a first for the Ship.
The company has performed 'chopstick' catches of its boosters before, but this is the first time the maneuver has successfully been executed on the Starship vehicle itself.

claims.statement: SpaceX had previously performed similar catches with Super Heavy boosters, but this was the first time for the Starship vehicle itself.

sources.quote: After aborting a planned catch of Starship Flight 15's booster, SpaceX successfully captured Starship

claims.statement: SpaceX had earlier aborted a planned catch of the Flight 15 booster before this successful catch.

analysis.headline: SpaceX catches Starship upper stage with tower for first time
analysis.summary: SpaceX's launch and catch tower successfully caught the Starship upper stage for the first time, after previously performing similar catches only with Super Heavy boosters. One report notes SpaceX had earlier aborted a planned catch of the same flight's booster.
